# `/managed-clients` endpoints

Base URL: `https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com`

### GET /managed-clients/v1

`getManagedClientsV1` — Get managed clients

List managed clients.

- Scopes: idn:remote-client:manage, idn:remote-client:read
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `offset` (query) — default 0 — Offset into the full result set. Usually specified with *limit* to paginate through the results. See [API Standard Collection…
  - `limit` (query) — max 250 — default 250 — Max number of results to return. See [API Standard Collection Parameters](https://developer.sailpoint.com/docs/api/standard-collection-parameters) for more information.
  - `count` (query) — default False — If *true* it will populate the *X-Total-Count* response header with the number of results that would be returned if *limit* and *offset* were ignored. Since requesting a total count can have a…
  - `filters` (query) — fields: id: eq; name: eq; clientId: eq; clusterId: eq — e.g. `name eq "client name"`
- Returns 200: array of managedclient

### POST /managed-clients/v1

`createManagedClientV1` — Create managed client

Create a new managed client. The API returns a result that includes the managed client ID.

- Scopes: idn:remote-client:manage
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN
- Body (application/json): managedclientrequest
- Returns 200: managedclient

### GET /managed-clients/v1/{id}

`getManagedClientV1` — Get managed client

Get managed client by ID.

- Scopes: idn:managed-client-status:manage, idn:managed-client-status:read, idn:remote-client:manage, idn:remote-client:read
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `id` (path, required) — Managed client ID.
- Returns 200: managedclient

### PATCH /managed-clients/v1/{id}

`updateManagedClientV1` — Update managed client

Update an existing managed client.

- Scopes: idn:remote-client:manage
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `id` (path, required) — Managed client ID.
- Body (application/json-patch+json): array of jsonpatchoperation
- Returns 200: managedclient

### DELETE /managed-clients/v1/{id}

`deleteManagedClientV1` — Delete managed client

Delete an existing managed client.

- Scopes: idn:remote-client:manage
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `id` (path, required) — Managed client ID.
- Returns 204: no body

### GET /managed-clients/v1/{id}/status

`getManagedClientStatusV1` — Get managed client status

Get a managed client's status, using its ID.

- Scopes: idn:managed-client-status:read
- Parameters:
  - `id` (path, required) — Managed client ID to get status for.
  - `type` (query, required) — one of CCG, VA, INTERNAL, IIQ_HARVESTER — Managed client type to get status for.
- Returns 200: managedclientstatus

### GET /managed-clients/v1/{id}/health-indicators

`getManagedClientHealthIndicatorsV1` — Get managed client health indicators

Get a managed client's health indicators, using its ID.

- Scopes: idn:remote-client:manage
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `id` (path, required) — Managed client ID to get health indicators for.
- Returns 200: managedclienthealthindicators
